newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT says plans to raise $2 bln next year.
newsitem.headline: PLDT says plans to raise $2 bln next year.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co will raise a further $2 billion starting in the first quarter of 1997 to finance its continuing expansion programme to meet growing competition, a senior PLDT official said on Monday.

"We'll go into the market, probably in the first quarter of next year. We won't raise $2 billion in one go, we'll do it in tranches," Antonio Samson, senior vice president, corporate services group, told Reuters in an interview.
"So far we've been doing it in tranches of 250 million dollars which has been very successful," Samson said.
The $2 billion will go towards installing two million additional telephone lines.
Samson said from 1993 until June this year, PLDT had spent 70 billion pesos ($2.67 billion) on its "zero-backlog" programme.
Samson said the company had not yet decided how the $2 billion would be raised and how much of it would be raised in overseas markets.
"It could be a combination of debt and equity. At this point we are not in a position to say what form. We'll probably engage the services of a financial adviser," he said.
